title: A manifest of exactly 65,536 characters is kept; one character more is refused
notes: The manifest holds a served skill, named with its origin and its description escaped, and two unavailable reasons in their wrapper. 'held' leaves room for 'other' with a 40-character reason: 41 characters are refused (65,537), and so is a 40-character reason whose '&' is escaped into five (65,540); the 40 characters are kept (exactly 65,536), and a third reason, even empty, is refused. 'held' is written with a two-byte character, so the kept manifest holds more than 65,536 bytes.
